# Browser dependencies

- Marked 18.0.14: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/releases/tag/v18.0.14 (MIT; bundled browser distribution from the official npm registry).
- DOMPurify 3.4.16: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/releases/tag/3.4.16 (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0; copyright/license notice is preserved in purify.min.js).

Files are served locally. The application does not load executable dependencies from a CDN at runtime. All model Markdown is sanitized before display.
